historical_contribution.unit: RUB per segment over first 30 days of each trial

fixed_coverage_accounts.formula: ceil(fixed / unit_contribution) if unit_contribution > 0 else null

conditional_setup_payback.formula: setup / monthly_balance if monthly_balance > 0 else null

rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to 2 places; coverage rounds upward to whole accounts; independent checks use Fraction and original XLSX XML
missing_policy: Unknown acquisition, taxes, renewals and exit costs stay unknown. Partial balances are not total profit.
scenario_policy: Monthly values are agency assumptions, not forecasts; repeat payments and stable costs are conditional. Do not extrapolate to accounting offices.
implementation: evidence/reproduce-analysis-v1.py; fixed arithmetic only, no eval or execution of source text
